versions.content: Ability to return an error from RTE API calls if no new data is received from COM The configuration of attribute NonqueuedReceiverComSpec. returnNoNewDataEnabled allows for the modification of RTE APIs related to the referenced dataElement in the context of the enclosing PortPrototype such that an error is returned if no new data is received from COM.

figures.why: Return error if no new data
